# TaskRoom — SEO & Indexing Setup Guide

## Files in this package

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `sitemap.xml` | XML sitemap with image extensions — submit to Google Search Console |
| `robots.txt` | Crawler rules — allow public pages + AI/AEO crawlers, block API/auth routes |
| `.htaccess` | Apache: HTTPS redirect, clean URLs, caching, compression (unused on Vercel — see note below) |
| `404.html` | Custom not-found page (keeps crawl budget clean) |
| `manifest.json` | PWA manifest for mobile install / app store signals |

**Not included, and cannot be generated by anyone but you:** `google-site-verification.html` and
`BingSiteAuth.xml`. These files/tokens are issued by Google and Microsoft only to whoever proves
ownership of taskroom.in by logging into Search Console / Bing Webmaster Tools with an account
that controls the domain (DNS or hosting access). No one else — including an AI assistant — can
generate a valid one on your behalf; a fabricated token would simply fail verification. Steps below
take about 2 minutes each.

---

## Step-by-step: get indexed in 48 hours

### 1. Verify with Google Search Console
1. Go to https://search.google.com/search-console, sign in with the Google account you want to own this property
2. Add property → URL prefix → `https://taskroom.in`
3. Easiest option: choose **HTML tag** verification — Google shows you a line like:
   ```html
   <meta name="google-site-verification" content="AbC123YourRealToken">
   ```
4. Paste your real token into the placeholder that's already commented out in every page's `<head>` (currently `<!-- <meta name="google-site-verification" content="REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_GSC_TOKEN"> -->`), then uncomment it
5. Click Verify in Search Console
6. (Alternative: HTML file method — Google gives you a file like `googleabc123.html` to upload to the site root instead of the meta tag. Either method works; you only need one.)

### 2. Submit your sitemap
1. In Search Console → Sitemaps
2. Enter: `https://taskroom.in/sitemap.xml`
3. Submit

### 3. Request indexing for each page
In Search Console → URL Inspection, paste each URL and click "Request indexing":
- `https://taskroom.in/`
- `https://taskroom.in/features`
- `https://taskroom.in/pricing`
- `https://taskroom.in/industries`
- `https://taskroom.in/mobile-app`

### 4. Verify Bing Webmaster
1. Go to https://www.bing.com/webmasters, sign in
2. Add site → you can import directly from Google Search Console (fastest — reuses your GSC verification), or verify independently via the XML file method, which gives you a real `BingSiteAuth.xml` to upload to the root
3. This file is unique to your account and can't be pre-generated

### 5. Replace the placeholder og-image.png
A generated placeholder OG image is already in the root at `og-image.png` so social shares and the
sitemap don't 404. Replace it with a real 1200×630px screenshot of your dashboard when you can —
it appears in Google, WhatsApp, and Twitter link previews.

## Hosting config notes

### cPanel / Shared hosting
Upload `.htaccess` to `public_html/`. It handles:
- HTTP → HTTPS redirect (301)
- www → non-www redirect (301)  
- `/features` → `/features.html` clean URLs
- Asset caching (1 year for CSS/JS, 1 week for HTML)
- Gzip compression

### Nginx (VPS)
Add to your server block:
```nginx
# Clean URLs
location / {
  try_files $uri $uri.html $uri/ =404;
}

# HTTPS redirect
server {
  listen 80;
  return 301 https://$host$request_uri;
}

# Cache headers
location ~* \.(css|js|png|jpg|webp|woff2)$ {
  expires 1y;
  add_header Cache-Control "public, immutable";
}
```

## Next steps to improve rankings

1. **Create an og-image.png** — improves CTR from Google dramatically
2. **Add Google Analytics** — paste GA4 tag in `<head>` of all pages
3. **Write blog content** — target "how to track field employees" type queries
4. **Get backlinks** — list on G2, Capterra, Product Hunt, IndiaMART
5. **Add reviews** — the AggregateRating schema is live; encourage reviews
